charge_port.notes: Estimated: The Charge Port US checker: I-PACE (2019-2024) CCS1, paid adapter; InsideEVs (Aug 2025): CCS1 port. Same port assumed on Canadian cars (no source shows otherwise).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: US owners can use Tesla Superchargers with a NACS-to-CCS1 adapter since Aug 2025 (InsideEVs); Jaguar had no approved adapter yet. Canada: the 2023 Jaguar release promised access in the United States, Canada and Mexico and adapters for I-PACE drivers once available (src-jlr-tesla-deal-2023); no Canadian go-live page found, so Canada is by analogy with the US.

wheels.notes: I-PACE S: 18 x 7.5 in aluminum (2020 S page). Carried from the 2020 S page; Cars.com has no 2021 I-PACE page, no page for this exact year opened.
I-PACE SE and HSE: 20 x 8 in (2019 SE/HSE and 2022 HSE pages agree). Carried from the 2019 and 2022 pages, no page for this exact year opened.
